SELECT a.audregistry, d.makername, d.modnum, a.thdpct, a.spksensedb, a.audlatms, 
       ROUND(CAST(((1 - a.thdpct/2.0) * (a.spksensedb/100.0) * (1 - a.audlatms/100.0) * 10) AS numeric(10,4)) as AQI
FROM audioandmedia a
JOIN deviceidentity d ON a.auddevref = d.devregistry
WHERE (1 - a.thdpct/2.0) * (a.spksensedb/100.0) * (1 - a.audlatms/100.0) * 10 > 8.0
ORDER BY AQI DESC
LIMIT 20

args.sql:
SELECT a.audregistry as audio_id, d.makername as maker, d.modnum as model, 
       t.battlifeh, d.pwractmw,
       ROUND(CAST((t.battlifeh * t.battcapmah) / (d.pwractmw * 10.0)) as BER,
       CASE WHEN (t.battlifeh * t.battcapmah) / (d.pwractmw * 10.0) > 7.5 THEN 'Excellent Efficiency'
            WHEN (t.battlifeh * t.battcapmah) / (d.pwractmw * 10.0) BETWEEN 5.0 AND 7.5 THEN 'Good Efficiency'
            WHEN (t.battlifeh * t.battcapmah) / (d.pwractmw * 10.0) BETWEEN 2.5 AND 4.9 THEN 'Average Efficiency'
            ELSE 'Poor Efficiency' END as efficiency_class
FROM audioandmedia a
JOIN deviceidentity d ON a.auddevref = d.devregistry
JOIN testsessions t ON d.devsessionref = t.sessionregistry
WHERE (t.battlifeh * t.battcapmah) / (d.pwractmw * 10.0) > 7.5
ORDER BY BER DESC
